abilities.name: Houndblade Charge
abilities.text: Once per turn, add +1 Grit to the first battle you start.

abilities.name: Loyal Guard
abilities.text: Once per round, when another operative in your sector would take 1 Wound, you may take that Wound instead and gain +1 on your next battle this turn.

abilities.name: Ash-Scent Tracker
abilities.text: Once per round, after threats are revealed in your sector, inspect one unresolved non-blue threat there.

abilities.name: Heroic Bite
abilities.text: After you defeat an enemy with difficulty 7 or higher, gain 1 Spoil. Weakness: Ash-Scent Tracker cannot inspect blue Anomalies.
